step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulation (DSM) Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory
step1_figure.description: Figure 17.18 shows the complete DSM sensing circuit for a 1T1R resistive memory cell, using a switched-capacitor charge pump (M1-M4, Ccup) controlled by non-overlapping clocks (phi1, phi2) and an offset clocked comparator (Figure 17.16) to balance the memory cell discharge current through Rmbit.

charge_per_pulse.description: Charge supplied by Ccup into the bit line per enabled feedback pulse

equation.explanation: Calculates the packet of charge dumped into the bit line when M1 precharges Ccup to VDD and M2, M3, M4 dump the charge until the source of M4 reaches VREF + |VTHP|.
equation.assumptions: M4 body tied to source/well to eliminate body effect; complete settling achieved.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Accounting for channel charge injection, parasitic capacitance on intermediate nodes, and incomplete settling at high frequency.

bitline_voltage_ripple.description: Maximum voltage change on the bit line during a single charge dump event

equation.explanation: Charge dumped by Ccup is absorbed by the total bitline capacitance Cbit, producing a voltage step.
equation.assumptions: Charge conservation between Ccup and Cbit during the phi2 pulse.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by capacitive division ratio of Ccup / Cbit multiplied by the effective charge swing.

comparator_offset_voltage.description: Built-in offset voltage of the clocked comparator created by input NMOS width mismatch

equation.formula: Vos = V(In+) - V(In-) at comparator trip point
equation.explanation: The comparator input transistor xm1 is intentionally sized wider (13/1 vs 10/1) to shift its threshold so that In+ must rise above In- by Vos to switch the regenerative latch.
equation.assumptions: Matched load PMOS transistors and symmetric cross-coupled latch.

sky130_expected.calculation: With sizing ratio of 1.3:1 between differential input pairs and overdrive of ~150-200 mV, Vos = sqrt(1.3 - 1) * Vov / 2 ~ 40 to 60 mV (typically ~50 mV in design).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Built-in geometry mismatch produces ~50 mV intentional offset to bias the bit line above VREF.

switched_capacitor_equivalent_resistance.description: Equivalent switched-capacitor resistance when M3 is permanently enabled (M = N)

equation.explanation: Calculates the effective minimum switched-capacitor resistance representing the maximum current feedback capability.
equation.assumptions: Operating frequency fclk = 100 MHz (T = 10 ns), Ccup = 100 fF.

sky130_expected.calculation: fclk = 100 MHz, Ccup = 100 fF. Rsc_min = 1 / (100 fF * 100 MHz) = 1 / (1e-13 * 1e8) = 100 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived strictly from capacitor size and clock rate.

minimum_detectable_resistance.description: Minimum cell resistance that can be sensed before DSM output saturates to all ones (M = N)

equation.explanation: The resistance at which the continuous memory discharge current equals the maximum charge-pump replenishment current.
equation.assumptions: Vos = 50 mV, T = 10 ns (100 MHz), M/N = 1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Below this resistance, the feedback pump cannot supply sufficient current and the DSM loops latches constantly to M=N.

average_cell_current.description: DC current flowing through the resistive memory cell during sensing

equation.explanation: Current drawn from the bit line through the memory cell resistance Rmbit under steady-state bitline regulation.
equation.assumptions: Bitline settles on average to VREF + Vos, Rmbit = 50 kOhm.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vos = 50 mV, Rmbit = 50 kOhm. Imbit = 50 mV / 50 kOhm = 1.0 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by comparator built-in offset divided by memory resistor value.

average_supply_current.description: Total average current drawn from VDD by the DSM sensing circuit

equation.explanation: Sum of dynamic switching currents in the switched capacitor branches, comparator toggling, and RS latch logic.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dynamic power of comparator clocked at 100 MHz plus Ccup charging current (88 fC * 100 MHz * M/N ~ 1-5 uA) yields 20 uA to 60 uA average current.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Analogous to 26 uA reported in Baker's text for 1V supply, scaling moderately higher with 1.8V supply in Sky130.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for the 1T1R DSM resistive memory sensing circuit in Figure 17.18 operating at 100 MHz clock frequency over 50 clock cycles (500 ns). Measures charge per pulse, bitline ripple, average bitline voltage, comparator offset, and supply current.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Delta-Sigma Modulation Sensing Circuit for Resistive Memory (Baker Fig. 17.18)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter settings for Sky130 devices
.param W_xm1=13u L_xm1=1u
.param W_xm2=20u L_xm2=1u
.param W_xm3=20u L_xm3=1u
.param W_xm4=20u L_xm4=1u
.param W_xm5=10u L_xm5=1u
.param W_xm6=10u L_xm6=1u
.param W_xm7=20u L_xm7=1u
.param W_xm8=10u L_xm8=1u
.param W_xm9=10u L_xm9=1u
.param W_xm10=10u L_xm10=1u
.param W_xm11=10u L_xm11=1u
.param W_xm12=10u L_xm12=1u

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VREF VREF 0 DC 0.5

* Switched Capacitor Network & Feedback Path (Top-level DUT)
xm3 N001 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm1 N002 phi2 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 N003 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
C1 N001 0 1e-13
xm4 vbit VREF N004 N004 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
X_U1 vbit VREF N003 Out clock VDD 0 SUB_1
Cbit vbit 0 5e-13
R1 VREF vbit 50000.0

* Clock Signals (T = 10ns, f = 100MHz)
* phi1: active low precharge pulse for Ccup
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 0.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10n)
* phi2: active low discharge pulse for Ccup
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 4.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.0n 10n)
* clock: active high sampling clock for comparator
Vclock clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 8.0n 0.1n 0.1n 1.5n 10n)

* Subcircuit: Clocked Comparator with Built-in Offset (Fig. 17.16)
.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

* Subcircuit: 2-input NAND Gate
.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

* Initial condition on bitline
.ic v(vbit)=0.5 v(N001)=1.8

* Control & Measurement Block
.control
tran 0.05n 500n 100n

* Measure maximum and minimum bitline voltage during steady state
meas tran vbit_max max v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
meas tran vbit_min min v(vbit) from=100n to=500n
meas tran vbit_avg avg v(vbit) from=100n to=500n

* Calculate ripple and comparator offset
let delta_vbit = vbit_max - vbit_min
let vos_meas = vbit_avg - 0.5
print delta_vbit
print vos_meas

* Measure average supply current and memory cell current
meas tran ivdd_avg avg i(VDD) from=100n to=500n
let pwr_avg = -ivdd_avg * 1.8
print pwr_avg

let imbit_avg = (vbit_avg - 0.5) / 50000.0
print imbit_avg

quit
.endc
.end
